## cargoship inventory

Generates a cluster inventory from another source of truth

### Synopsis

Generates the cluster inventory cargoship installs from, out of a description of the fleet that already exists somewhere else. These commands install nothing and touch no hosts; they write a file for 'cargoship validate' to check and 'cargoship apply' to read.

      --age-recipients-file stringArray   File of public keys, one per line; an authorized_keys file works. See docs/guides/age-encryption.md.
